items: KATSINA STATE (PSI 9.2): Katsina Hits Over 30MW Renewable Energy Milestone as Governor Radda Unveils State Climate Policy
ABIA STATE (PSI 9.0): Gov Otti Flags Off Reconstruction of Uratta and Old Express Roads in Aba; Announces 10 New Courthouses
LAGOS STATE (PSI 8.7): Lagos OEQA Seeks Global Best Practices To Strengthen Education Quality Assurance
KEBBI STATE (PSI 8.6): Gov Idris Flags Off Construction of 102km Unguwar Jeji–Diggi–Maidahini and Bunza–Makera Rural Roads
DELTA STATE (PSI 8.5): Delta State House of Assembly Approves Proposed Sixth Alteration Bill for State Police
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.4): Zamfara Govt Unveils Fresh Security Measures, Trains 1,000 Forest Guards and Deploys 25 APCs
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.3): Plateau Free Medical Outreach Records Impact in Shendam and Mangu as Beneficiary Names Baby Caleb
EDO STATE (PSI 8.2): Edo State Seeks Partnership With Netherlands On Climate Change, Biodiversity and Oil Palm Sustainability
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.0): Ogun Approves ₦50,000 Welfare Palliative for 3,050 NYSC Corps Members and Donates 500 Mattresses
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov Fintiri Appoints Prof Ibrahim Danjuma New Rector For Adamawa State Polytechnic
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.5): Governor Inuwa Yahaya Appoints Rev. Wakil Joel Phillip as Executive Secretary of Christian Pilgrims Welfare Board
KADUNA STATE (PSI 5.0): KADSUBEB Issues Disclaimer on False Teacher Recruitment Information
CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.3): Presented proposed N987.8bn 2027 budget allocating N708.4bn (71.72%) to capital projects, while Assembly passed State Police bill and launched Climate Transition Plan.
KATSINA (PSI 9.2): Unveiled Climate Change Policy in Abuja, disclosing 30MW+ solar capacity deployed toward 70MW target, ₦7.6bn solar lighting, and 11M tree initiative.
ABIA (PSI 9.0): Flagged off reconstruction of 3.1km Uratta and 3.95km Old Express roads in Aba under AfDB/IsDB project, and announced 10 ultra-modern courthouses.
LAGOS (PSI 8.7): Hosted Finnish education experts at OEQA roundtable to benchmark digital monitoring, school self-evaluation, and post-primary teacher capacity building.
KEBBI (PSI 8.6): Flagged off construction of two rural roads spanning 102km to connect agrarian communities to commercial markets and ease agricultural transit.
DELTA (PSI 8.5): State Assembly passed 1999 Constitution Sixth Alteration Bill with 23 votes to establish State Police, transmitting resolution to National Assembly.
ZAMFARA (PSI 8.4): Announced training of 1,000 Forest Guards, deployment of 150 Hilux vans, 25 APCs, and drones to secure rural farming communities against banditry.
PLATEAU (PSI 8.3): Delivered free surgical operations, consultations, and emergency Caesarean sections across Shendam and Mangu General Hospitals for indigent residents.
EDO (PSI 8.2): Engaged Netherlands Consul-General on EdoFEWMA erosion control and NISCOPS smallholder oil palm, while mediating Urhonigbe-Platform Petroleum dispute.
OGUN (PSI 8.0): Approved ₦50,000 direct cash palliative for each of 3,050 NYSC corps members in Sagamu orientation camp and donated 500 mattresses.
ADAMAWA (PSI 7.8): Appointed Prof. Ibrahim Danjuma as Adamawa State Polytechnic Rector and partnered with Ethics Corps on public ethics and environmental compliance.
GOMBE (PSI 7.5): Appointed Rev. Wakil Joel Phillip as Executive Secretary of the Gombe State Christian Pilgrims Welfare Board to coordinate pilgrim welfare.
KADUNA (PSI 5.0): Issued an official public alert disclaiming false social media rumors regarding CV collection for basic education teacher recruitment.
